test_name: Verify User Search Functionality in Admin Panel
description: This test ensures that an admin can search for users in the user list using the search functionality.
steps: Log in as an admin user.
Navigate to the Admin tab using the 'Admin' link.
Type 'harish' into the search input field.
Press Enter or click the 'Search' button.
Verify that the user list updates to show only users matching the search term.
Verify that the full user list is displayed again.
expected_results: Only users matching the search term are displayed.
The full user list is restored when the search term is cleared.
edge_cases: Search term is empty and Enter is pressed.
Search input field is disabled or inaccessible.
data_requirements: A user named 'harish' in the user list.
At least one other user in the user list.
Database access to validate search results.
dependencies: Admin user must be logged in.
User list must be loaded correctly.
Search input field must be visible.
API call for search functionality must be working.
The database must contain user data.
api_interactions: API call to fetch search results.
performance_metrics: Time taken to display search results.
Response time of the search API.
accessibility_requirements: Verify the search input field has a proper ARIA label.
Ensure search results are navigable using the keyboard.
Check for a visible focus indicator on the search field.
Ensure error messages for invalid inputs are accessible.
Verify that placeholder text in the search field is descriptive.
